name: 3M ELITE v1
description: Partial implementation of the SPENNYFX 3M SYSTEM CHECKLIST, scaled to a 3-minute entry using the authors' own ratios: 12H bias, 3H supply/demand zone, 48m structure, 3m entry. All higher timeframes are reconstructed from 1m bars by timestamp arithmetic. Implemented: structural bias per layer, break counting with the 6/4 caps, zone tap, Keltner overextension from the 20MA, MAs-not-fully-against-bias, and the 20/50 slope gate. Risk uses a structural stop at the 3H zone edge with the source's own ATR take-profit method (12x ATR), both fixed at entry.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// 3M ELITE v1 — BTCUSDT, 1m base chart.
// Cascade per the 3M SYSTEM CHECKLIST, scaled to a 3-minute entry using the authors' own ratios:
//   BIAS 12H -> ZONE 3H -> STRUCTURE 48m -> ENTRY 3m
// Every higher timeframe is rebuilt from 1m timestamps (exact: a 3m candle IS 3 consecutive 1m bars).
//
// IMPLEMENTED from the checklists: model/structural bias, break counting with caps, supply/demand
// zone tap, Keltner overextension from the 20MA, MA stack not fully against bias, 20/50 slope gate,
// structural stop, ATR take-profit (the source's 12x ATR method).
// NOT IMPLEMENTED (undefined in the checklists, needs the videos): Type 1/Type 2 validation,
// the swing rule, and the stage gate. This is therefore a PARTIAL implementation.
strategy("3M ELITE v1", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

maxBreakHi = input.int(6,    "Max breaks on bias/zone/structure")
maxBreakEn = input.int(4,    "Max breaks on the entry timeframe")
kcMult     = input.float(2.0,"Keltner width for overextension, x ATR")
slopeLen   = input.int(10,   "Bars used for MA slope")
zoneTolK   = input.float(0.25,"Zone tap tolerance, x atr(30)")
bufK       = input.float(0.25,"Structural stop buffer, x atr(30)")
tpATR      = input.float(12.0,"Take profit, x ATR (source's ATR method)")
minRpct    = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct    = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars    = input.int(1440, "Max bars in trade")

MS3M  = 180000
MS48M = 2880000
MS3H  = 10800000
MS12H = 43200000

b3   = math.floor(time / MS3M)
b48  = math.floor(time / MS48M)
b3h  = math.floor(time / MS3H)
b12h = math.floor(time / MS12H)

new3   = b3   != b3[1]
new48  = b48  != b48[1]
new3h  = b3h  != b3h[1]
new12h = b12h != b12h[1]

// ---------- reconstructed candles: open/high/low, and the previous completed close ----------
var float o3 = na
var float h3 = na
var float l3 = na
var float c3prev = na
var float c3prev2 = na
if new3
    c3prev2 := c3prev
    c3prev  := close[1]
    o3 := open
    h3 := high
    l3 := low
else
    h3 := na(h3) ? high : math.max(h3, high)
    l3 := na(l3) ? low  : math.min(l3, low)

var float h48 = na
var float l48 = na
var float c48prev = na
var float c48prev2 = na
if new48
    c48prev2 := c48prev
    c48prev  := close[1]
    h48 := high
    l48 := low
else
    h48 := na(h48) ? high : math.max(h48, high)
    l48 := na(l48) ? low  : math.min(l48, low)

var float c3hH = na
var float c3hL = na
var float p3hH = na
var float p3hL = na
var float c3hprev = na
var float c3hprev2 = na
if new3h
    c3hprev2 := c3hprev
    c3hprev  := close[1]
    p3hH := c3hH
    p3hL := c3hL
    c3hH := high
    c3hL := low
else
    c3hH := na(c3hH) ? high : math.max(c3hH, high)
    c3hL := na(c3hL) ? low  : math.min(c3hL, low)

var float c12prev = na
var float c12prev2 = na
if new12h
    c12prev2 := c12prev
    c12prev  := close[1]

// ---------- LAYER 1: BIAS (12H) model = two consecutive same-direction closes ----------
biasBull = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev > c12prev2
biasBear = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev < c12prev2

// ---------- LAYER 2: ZONE (3H) model agrees + supply/demand tap ----------
zoneBull = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev > c3hprev2
zoneBear = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev < c3hprev2

atr30 = ta.atr(30)
tol   = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * zoneTolK
// demand tap: price trades back down into the previous completed 3H candle's low area
demandTap = not na(p3hL) and low  <= p3hL + tol
supplyTap = not na(p3hH) and high >= p3hH - tol

// ---------- LAYER 3: STRUCTURE (48m) model agrees ----------
structBull = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev > c48prev2
structBear = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev < c48prev2

// ---------- break counting: a break is a close beyond the prior 20-bar extreme ----------
brkUpLvl = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
brkDnLvl = ta.lowest(low,  20)[1]
brokeUp  = ta.crossover(close, brkUpLvl)
brokeDn  = ta.crossunder(close, brkDnLvl)
var int upCount = 0
var int dnCount = 0
if brokeUp
    upCount := upCount + 1
    dnCount := 0
if brokeDn
    dnCount := dnCount + 1
    upCount := 0

// ---------- MAs on the entry timeframe ----------
ma20  = ta.ema(close, 20)
ma50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ma200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

// Keltner overextension around the 20MA (the 30SEC checklist names Keltner explicitly)
atr14  = ta.atr(14)
kcUp   = ma20 + kcMult * atr14
kcDn   = ma20 - kcMult * atr14
notExtLong  = close < kcUp
notExtShort = close > kcDn

// MAs not FULLY against bias: all three stacked the wrong way is the veto
fullyAgainstLong  = ma20 < ma50 and ma50 < ma200
fullyAgainstShort = ma20 > ma50 and ma50 > ma200

// 20 & 50 not overextended from the 200
maSpreadOk = not na(ma200) and ma200 > 0 and math.abs(ma20 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0 and math.abs(ma50 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0

// slope gate: either the 20 or the 50 must favour the trade
slope20Up = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 > ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Up = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 > ma50[slopeLen]
slope20Dn = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 < ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Dn = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 < ma50[slopeLen]
slopeOkLong  = slope20Up or slope50Up
slopeOkShort = slope20Dn or slope50Dn

// ---------- the gated cascade ----------
longStack  = biasBull and zoneBull and structBull and demandTap and notExtLong  and not fullyAgainstLong  and maSpreadOk and slopeOkLong  and upCount <= maxBreakEn and dnCount <= maxBreakHi
shortStack = biasBear and zoneBear and structBear and supplyTap and notExtShort and not fullyAgainstShort and maSpreadOk and slopeOkShort and dnCount <= maxBreakEn and upCount <= maxBreakHi

// entry trigger on the 3m close, in the direction of bias
goLong  = longStack  and new3 and close > o3
goShort = shortStack and new3 and close < o3

// ---------- risk: structural stop beyond the zone, ATR take profit per the source ----------
buf  = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawLongR  = na(p3hL) ? na : close - (p3hL - buf)
rawShortR = na(p3hH) ? na : (p3hH + buf) - close
longR     = na(rawLongR)  ? na : math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = na(rawShortR) ? na : math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and not na(longR) and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and not na(shortR) and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(biasBull ? 1 : biasBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Bias12H")
plot(zoneBull ? 1 : zoneBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Zone3H")
plot(structBull ? 1 : structBear ? -1 : 0, title="Struct48m")
plot(upCount,                              title="BreaksUp")
plot(dnCount,                              title="BreaksDown")
notes: FIRST BUILD, PARTIAL IMPLEMENTATION. Three checklist gates are undefined in the PDFs and are NOT implemented: Type 1/Type 2 validation, the swing rule, and the stage gate. Their absence is the most likely reason this understates the real system, so read PF 0.91 as a lower bound, not a verdict. Leg split: longs 8 trades (6 winners, 75%, +$186), shorts 12 (2 winners, 16.7%, -$228) -- the long side is already strongly positive on a tiny sample and the short side is the loser, the same pattern as every other strategy in this project. name: 3M ELITE v3 (15m base port)
description: The same cascade and the same ladder ratios as v1, ported one zoom level up to a 15m entry: structure 4H, zone 12H, bias 2D. The author scales his own system this way between his 15sec and 30sec variants. No new filters were added -- this run exists purely to escape the 4.6-month 1m data limit and measure the cascade on 4.7 years instead.
notes: THIS SUPERSEDES v1 AS THE REFERENCE MEASUREMENT, despite the lower profit factor. v1 showed PF 0.91 on 20 trades across 4.6 months; v3 shows PF 0.64 on 94 trades across 4.7 years of the SAME cascade. The larger sample is the trustworthy one, and it says v1's 0.91 was noise. Leg split: longs 35 trades (10 winners, 28.6%, -$576), shorts 59 (5 winners, 8.5%, -$820) -- both lose, shorts much worse, the same pattern as every short in this project. Payoff ratio 3.37:1 needs ~23% wins to break even and delivered 16.0%. This is the sample-size fix doing its job: it did not improve the strategy, it revealed that the earlier number was not evidence. Gates can now be tested against a base with a usable trade count.

name: 3M ELITE v5 latched tap + Type 2 validation
description: Queue item 0-V5. The zone tap now LATCHES instead of being required on the entry bar, and the latch lives until the zone invalidates (a completed 12H candle whose body closes beyond it). While the latch is live, an engulfing 4H candle in the direction of bias fires the entry. This merges queue items 0a and 0b into one mechanism and fixes the HARD LESSON 8 defect behind v2 and v4.
notes: THE LATCH WORKS BUT A SECOND SIMULTANEITY BUG REMAINS. 2 trades over 4.7 years, both losses -- a meaningless sample, recorded for provenance, NOT evidence about the strategy. The progress is real: v2 and v4 produced zero trades and this produced some, so latching the tap fixed the defect it was meant to fix. The remaining defect is the same shape one level down. validBull is true for exactly ONE bar every four hours, the instant a new 4H candle opens behind an engulfing one, and every other gate (bias, zone, structure, slope, extension, break counts) must happen to be true on that same bar. The VALIDATION must latch too. In the source a validation persists until the zone invalidates -- it is a state, not an instant. v6 latches both.

name: 3M ELITE v6 tap and validation both latched
description: Queue item 0-V6. Both the zone tap and the Type 2 engulfing validation are persistent states that die together when a completed 12H candle body closes beyond the zone. Entry fires on the first bar where both are live and the trend and extension gates permit. Type 2 only; Type 1 (the 3M candle) is still undefined in the source.
notes: FIRST POSITIVE RESULT IN THIS LAB, AND EXPLICITLY NOT YET EVIDENCE. PF 1.77, net +3.10%, longs 5 (2 wins, +$297.97), shorts 5 (1 win, +$12.05) -- both legs positive, the short essentially flat. The mechanism finally behaves as the source describes: zero trades at v2 and v4, 2 at v5, 10 here. But TEN TRADES IN 4.7 YEARS IS NOT A SAMPLE. This lab has already been burned by exactly this: v1 showed PF 0.91 on 20 trades and the same cascade on a proper sample gave PF 0.64 on 94. The honest reading is that the mechanism is now correctly implemented and the frequency is still far too low to test it. Do NOT promote this over v3 as the reference base on these numbers.

name: 3M ELITE v7 source rules only
description: Queue item 0-V7, run as a measurement. The four lab-invented gates (MA-spread test, break counters, MA slope test, Keltner overextension check) are removed, leaving only the author's own rules: 2D bias, 12H zone, 4H structure, the latched tap and the Type 2 validation. Tests whether the 10-trade frequency of v6 was caused by my additions.
notes: THE MEASUREMENT ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER WAS NOT WHAT I EXPECTED. Removing four gates left the trade count at exactly 10, unchanged from v6 (still 5 long, 5 short). My additions were NOT binding. The frequency ceiling comes from the SOURCE-derived conjunction itself -- 2D bias, 12H zone and 4H structure all having to rise together while a tap and a validation are both live. PF fell 1.77->1.32 on the same tiny sample, which is noise either way and is not a reason to keep the invented gates. The next question is therefore a specification question, not a tuning one: requiring bias, zone AND structure to agree may be my reading of 'direction' rather than his, and the latched tap plus validation may already encode the location those three were meant to establish.

name: 3M ELITE v9 engulfing-created zones
description: First build on the corrected model. An engulfing 4H candle CREATES a zone spanning it plus the following candle; the zone stays unmitigated until a second 4H candle enters it (the One Candle Rule); entry is the first return into a live zone with the 2D bias agreeing. Replaces the inverted model in v1-v7. Both legs from the author's symmetric definition, reported separately.
notes: THE MODEL IS RIGHT; THE SINGLE-SLOT APPROXIMATION IS WRONG, AND I FLAGGED IT BEFORE RUNNING. 3 trades (2 long, 1 short), down from v6's 10. The cause is precisely the deviation declared in the source comment: Pine forbids arrays, so only ONE zone per side is tracked and every new engulfing candle overwrites the previous zone. In a trending market engulfing candles arrive every few 4H bars, so a zone is almost never still alive when price returns to it. The source says to trade the DEEPEST UNMITIGATED zone, which presupposes several being tracked at once. Fix in v10 is one line and follows the source directly: replace the tracked zone only when the new one is DEEPER (lower bottom for demand, higher top for supply), or when the current one is dead. Do not read PF 0.64 on 3 trades as information about the model.

name: 3M ELITE v10 deepest unmitigated zone
description: Queue item 0-V10. One line changed from v9: a new engulfing candle replaces the tracked zone only if it is deeper (lower bottom for demand, higher top for supply) or the tracked zone is already dead, implementing the source's deepest unmitigated zone. Both legs reported separately.
notes: IDENTICAL TO v9 IN EVERY FIGURE, AND THAT IS THE DIAGNOSIS. Same PF 0.64013804, same 3 trades, same net. If overwriting had been the cause of v9's scarcity, requiring the new zone to be deeper would have changed something. It changed nothing, which proves the selection rule never fires: zones are already DEAD by the time the next engulfing candle arrives, so the guard clause always sees a dead zone and replaces it exactly as v9 did. THE REAL DEFECT IS THE ZONE GEOMETRY. I defined a demand zone as the engulfing candle's whole high-to-low range, so the zone TOP equals the impulse high -- price is inside the zone the instant the candle closes. The mitigation test then trips within two candles every time. In supply and demand a zone is the BASE the impulse left behind, not the impulse itself. v11 must fix the geometry before any selection rule can matter.

name: 3M ELITE v11 corrected zone geometry
description: Queue item 0-V11. The zone is redefined as the BASE the impulse left behind -- demand [low, open] of the bullish engulfing candle, supply [open, high] of the bearish one -- rather than the candle's whole range. Both legs reported separately.
notes: THE GEOMETRY FIX WAS REAL BUT IT WAS NOT THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. Still 3 trades, though the composition changed (1 long 2 short, against v10's 2 long 1 short), which confirms the code genuinely behaves differently. THREE SUCCESSIVE STRUCTURAL FIXES HAVE NOW ALL LANDED ON ROUGHLY THREE TRADES -- v9 the latched model, v10 the deepest-zone rule, v11 the base geometry. When three independent corrections produce the same trade count, the limiting factor is upstream of all of them. STOP GUESSING AND MEASURE: v12 must be a DIAGNOSTIC that strips the entry to nothing but 'a zone is live and price is inside it', with no bias, no direction and no candle-colour condition, purely to count how many opportunities exist at all. Filtering a population before knowing its size is what produced these last three cycles.

name: 3M ELITE v12 opportunity counter (diagnostic)
description: A COUNTER, NOT A STRATEGY. Entry stripped to one condition -- a zone is live and price has just entered it -- with no bias, direction or candle-colour requirement, and every position closed after one bar so the trade count equals the opportunity count. Only totalTrades, longTrades and shortTrades carry information; the P&L is meaningless by construction.
notes: THE MEASUREMENT: 15 OPPORTUNITIES IN 4.7 YEARS. 6 long, 9 short. Do not read the profit factor -- exits are forced after one bar, so the P&L is an artefact of the instrument. THE ANSWER IS DECISIVE AND IT IS NOT THE FILTERS. With every gate removed the population is 15; with all gates on it was 3. So the bias and direction conditions cut 15 to 3, but 15 was never enough to begin with. THE ZONE LIFECYCLE IS THE BINDING CONSTRAINT, exactly as the diagnostic was designed to determine. Prime suspect is the mitigation test: dzTouch increments whenever a 4H candle's LOW dips below the zone top, so a single wick counts as a touch and two wicks kill the zone, typically within eight hours of creation. The source judges invalidation on the BODY, and the One Candle Rule is about candles closing back into the zone. v13 should require a BODY inside the zone to count as mitigation.

name: 3M ELITE v13 body mitigation (counter)
description: A COUNTER, NOT A STRATEGY. Mitigation now requires a completed 4H candle to CLOSE inside the zone rather than merely wick into it. Run in v12 counter form with entry stripped to one condition and one-bar exits, so the trade count is the opportunity count and is directly comparable with v12's 15. P&L is meaningless by construction.
notes: THE FIX WORKS: OPPORTUNITIES 15 -> 40, nearly tripled, over the same 4.7 years. 13 long, 27 short. DO NOT READ THE PROFIT FACTOR -- exits are forced after one bar, so P&L is an artefact of the instrument, exactly as in v12. The wick-counting diagnosis was correct: zones were being killed by candles that dipped a wick into them without ever closing inside, which the source never treats as mitigation. Judging mitigation on the BODY is now the settled rule. 40 in 4.7 years is still thin for a strategy that then applies bias, direction and colour filters -- v9/v10/v11 cut 15 down to 3, so a similar ratio would leave roughly 8 -- so the next cycle should restore the filters ONE at a time onto this corrected lifecycle and measure what each costs, rather than switching them all on at once.

name: 3M ELITE v14 unfiltered zone edge
description: v13's repaired lifecycle (engulf-created base zones, deepest-zone rule, body mitigation) with NO bias, direction or candle-colour filter, but with REAL fixed exits instead of the counter's one-bar close. Asks whether the zone population has any edge before restoring filters. Both legs reported separately.
notes: THE EXIT IS BROKEN, AND THAT INVALIDATES THE QUESTION THIS RUN ASKED. Win rate 4.17% -- one winner against twenty-three losers -- with avgWin 306.97 against avgLoss 45.99, a payoff ratio of 6.67. The distribution is the tell: avgBarsWinning is 96, which is EXACTLY maxBars, while avgBarsLosing is 18.5. So the single winner exited at the TIME CAP, not at the target, and NO TRADE IN 4.7 YEARS EVER REACHED THE TAKE PROFIT. tpATR = 12 x ATR14 on 15m is an unreachable target that has been carried unexamined since v1, so the system has been structurally stop-or-timeout the whole time and the reward leg has never paid. THEREFORE DO NOT CONCLUDE THE ZONES ARE UNPREDICTIVE -- that question is still open and this run could not answer it. Long 5 (0 wins), short 19 (1 win); the short skew is itself worth noting once the exit is fixed. v15 must replace the ATR target with a fixed multiple of R, 2R as in the other labs, and re-ask the question.

name: 3M ELITE v15 reachable 2R target
description: Replaces the unreachable 12 x ATR14 target with a fixed 2R, matching both other labs, and re-asks v14's question: does the repaired zone population have an edge before any filter? Still no bias, direction or candle-colour condition. Both legs reported separately.
notes: THE TARGET FIX WORKED AND THE ANSWER IS STILL NO -- BUT THE REASON IS INFORMATIVE. PF 0.290->0.363 and win rate 4.17%->8.33%, with two winners now actually reaching the target (avgBarsWinning 43.5 against maxBars 96), so v14's diagnosis that the exit was unreachable is confirmed. THE DECISIVE COMPARISON IS AGAINST CHANCE: a coin flip with a 2R target and a 1R stop wins about 33% of the time. These entries win 8.33%, a quarter of that, which means they are not merely unpredictive but SYSTEMATICALLY BADLY TIMED -- price is far more likely to continue through the zone than to reverse off it. Longs 5 (1 win), shorts 19 (1 win). THE RIGHT READING IS NOT THAT THE SYSTEM FAILS. It is that entering on the FIRST TOUCH of a zone is premature, and the source never says to do that -- it requires a VALIDATION inside the zone (a 3M candle or an engulfing candle) before entry, which this diagnostic deliberately removed. Being worse than chance without the validation is evidence that the validation is LOAD-BEARING, not optional. v16 restores the Type 2 validation on this corrected lifecycle.

name: 3M ELITE v19 engulf counter (diagnostic)
description: A COUNTER, NOT A STRATEGY. Fires on any 4H engulfing candle with no other condition and a one-bar exit, so totalTrades is the engulf count. Isolates the one term in the validation gate that had never been measured. P&L meaningless by construction.
notes: TEN ENGULFING CANDLES IN 4.7 YEARS -- 5 bullish, 5 bearish, across roughly 9,800 four-hour candles. That is 0.1%, and it explains every zero-trade run from v16 onward: the conjunction could never fire because the engulf term is essentially non-existent. THE CAUSE IS A DEFINITION THAT ASSUMES GAPS, IN A MARKET THAT HAS NONE. The test carried since v9 is `close > prevOpen AND open < prevClose`. In a 24/7 market the open of one aggregated candle equals the close of the previous one almost exactly, so `open < prevClose` is decided by tick noise rather than by structure and is effectively never true. That condition is imported from equities, where overnight gaps make it meaningful. THE FIX for v20 is a body-containment definition with no gap requirement: a bullish engulf is a bullish candle whose CLOSE exceeds the previous candle's OPEN, with the previous candle bearish. Drop the open-versus-previous-close term entirely. This is the fourth carried-from-v1 error this lab has found, after the inverted zone model, wick-based mitigation and the unreachable target.

name: 3M ELITE v20 corrected engulf counter (diagnostic)
description: A COUNTER, NOT A STRATEGY. The corrected engulf definition -- body containment only, no gap requirement -- fired with no other condition and a one-bar exit, so totalTrades is the engulf count and the long/short split separates bullish from bearish. P&L meaningless by construction.
notes: 2,711 ENGULFS VERSUS 10. Dropping the gap clause multiplied the population by 271x: 1,325 bullish and 1,386 bearish across 4.7 years, near-perfectly balanced, roughly 28% of all 4H candles. The old definition was not selective, it was BROKEN -- an equities rule requiring a gap, applied to a 24/7 market where an aggregated candle's open equals the previous close. Every zero-and-three-trade run from v16 on was starved by this one clause. The validation gate can now be restored on a real population.

name: 3M ELITE v21 corrected engulf zones
description: v15's exact recovered source with one change: the engulf definition corrected to body containment. v15 still carried the gap-requiring form, so every zone this lab has ever created -- including the v3 reference base -- was built from the population of ten that v20 proved broken. This is the zone CREATION step running on a real population for the first time, deliberately before any validation gate.
notes: BEST 3M RESULT ON RECORD, WITH A DISCLOSED ANOMALY. PF 0.3626 -> 1.0239, trades 24 -> 185, DD 15.53% -> 10.58%. Longs 56 (21W, +$652.14); shorts 129 (25W, -$423.19) -- the long leg carries it and the short leg loses, matching both sister labs. THE ANOMALY: the last trade exits 2025-10-06 but the window runs to 2026-09-01, so roughly eleven months produced no entries at all. Suspected cause is the deepest-zone rule -- in a rising market a live demand zone can never be replaced by a shallower one, so it persists untouched and blocks demand entries indefinitely. NOT PROMOTED past reference until that is measured. PF 1.02 is break-even plus noise regardless.

name: 3M ELITE v22 zone-creation counter (diagnostic)
description: A COUNTER, NOT A STRATEGY. Fires on the zone-CREATION event itself -- the engulf AND the deepest-zone condition, the conjunction that has never been counted -- with a one-bar exit, so totalTrades is the creation count and the long/short split separates demand from supply. P&L meaningless by construction.
notes: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED, AND WORSE THAN PREDICTED. 2,711 engulfs produce only 71 zone creations -- 29 demand, 42 supply -- which is 2.6%. The deepest-zone rule discards 97.4% of them. AND CREATION STOPS: the last one is 2025-10-07, matching v21's last trade on 2025-10-06 almost exactly. So v21's eleven-month gap is not a market feature, it is a lock-up: once an incumbent zone can only be replaced by a deeper (or higher) one, a trending market can never replace it, and if price never returns to mitigate it the zone sits forever and blocks the side permanently.

name: 3M ELITE v23 most-recent zone
description: One change from v21: the deepest-zone clause is dropped, so every engulf creates or replaces its zone and the freshest structure always wins. This removes the lock-up v22 proved. First measurement of this system that is not distorted by a zone going permanently blind.
notes: THE LOCK-UP IS FIXED AND THE EDGE WAS THE LOCK-UP. Trades 185 to 1792 and they now span the whole window to 2026-08 instead of stopping in 2025-10, so the fix works exactly as v22 predicted. But profit factor falls 1.02389497 to 0.73626670. Longs 749 (275W, -$1,814.86); shorts 1043 (184W, -$7,081.71). v21's 1.02 was not an edge -- it was an accidental filter, a frozen zone that happened to sit in a favourable place while the strategy was blind to everything else. This is the FIRST undistorted measurement of the SPENNYFX mechanism on this engine, and it says 0.736. Recorded as the reference base on correctness grounds despite the lower number. DD 89% -- not tradeable.

name: 3M ELITE v24 long leg alone
description: One change from v23: short entries removed, so the demand side is judged on its own profit factor (LESSON 6). The queue's Type 2 gate item was deliberately deferred because the bias term it needs comes from a closed-source indicator, and reconstructing it would test an invention rather than the system.
notes: THE LONG LEG IS THE WHOLE SYSTEM. PF 0.73626670 combined becomes 0.89445064 long-only, win rate 25.61% becomes 36.61%, payoff 1.548. This is the best honest number this lab has produced on a real sample and it is still below 1.0. Trade count rises 749 to 833 because the short leg was blocking demand entries under pyramiding=1, so the legs were NOT independent here -- unlike the BTC lab where the long count was identical with and without the short. Drawdown 42.5% is not tradeable. The finding stands: the short side is not underperforming, it is the entire deficit.

name: 3M ELITE v25 wider time stop
description: The first exit test this lab has run. One change from v24: maxBars 96 to 192, widening the time stop from 24 to 48 hours at 15m. Entries, stops, target and zone lifecycle byte-identical. Motivated by v24's own statistics -- winners averaged 48.83 bars against a 96-bar cap, so the cap was suspected of truncating the right tail.
notes: THE CAP WAS CUTTING LOSERS, NOT WINNERS. PF 0.89445064 to 0.85781046 and drawdown 42.50% to 53.38% -- worse on both. The hypothesis was that a 96-bar cap truncated winners averaging 48.83 bars; the opposite is true. Widening it moved avgBarsWinning only 48.83 to 53.64 while avgBarsLosing rose 27.26 to 33.14, so the extra room went mostly to losing trades. Trade count also FELL 833 to 797, because longer holds block new entries under pyramiding=1 -- the exit and the entry frequency are coupled, which no cycle here had accounted for. REVERTED; v24 stands.

name: 3M ELITE v26 tighter time stop
description: The other direction on the exit axis. One change from v24: maxBars 96 to 48, tightening the time stop from 24 to 12 hours at 15m. Entries, stops, the 2R target and the zone lifecycle byte-identical. Motivated by v25, which established that widening the cap makes both terms worse.
notes: THE TIME STOP HAS AN INTERIOR OPTIMUM AND v24 IS SITTING ON IT. 48 bars: PF 0.82035131, DD 58.85%, 915 trades. 96 bars (v24): PF 0.89445064, DD 42.50%, 833. 192 bars (v25): PF 0.85781046, DD 53.38%, 797. Both directions are worse, so 96 is a local maximum on this axis and the axis is closed. THE PREDICTION WAS HALF RIGHT AND THAT IS THE USEFUL PART: win rate rose exactly as expected, 36.61% to 40.33%, because the cap cuts losers earlier -- but payoff collapsed 1.548 to 1.214, so break-even moved from 39.2% to 45.2% and the gap WIDENED from 2.6 points to 4.9. Trade count rose 833 to 915, confirming v25's coupling finding by prediction rather than hindsight. REVERTED; v24 stands.

name: 3M ELITE v27 2.5R target
description: The last untouched exit parameter. One change from v24: rr 2.0 to 2.5. Entries, stops, the 96-bar time stop and the zone lifecycle byte-identical. Run to close the axis rather than in expectation of a gain -- two sister labs had already found the risk-reward axis neutral once and negative once.
notes: THE EXIT AXIS IS NOW FULLY CLOSED. PF 0.89445064 to 0.88039828, DD 42.50% to 45.88%. Payoff rose 1.548 to 1.738 (+12.3%) and win rate fell 36.61% to 33.62% (-3.0pp) -- almost exactly the iso-profit-factor trade the BTC lab found at 2R vs 3R, with a small net loss. Break-even moved 39.2% to 36.5% while actual fell to 33.62%, so the gap widened 2.6 to 2.9 points. BOTH FORWARD PREDICTIONS CONFIRMED: the axis would not help, and trade count would fall (833 to 803) because a further target lengthens holds and held positions block entries. Third instance across three mechanisms of the risk-reward axis being neutral-to-negative. REVERTED; v24 stands.

name: 3M ELITE v28a first half (walk-forward)
description: First half of the walk-forward split of v24. The Pine is byte-identical to v24 -- only the window changes. Run to test whether PF 0.894 is a stable property of the mechanism or an average of two different regimes, as the BTC base turned out to be. The second half runs next cycle, since this lab allows one backtest per cycle.
notes: PRELIMINARY AND ENCOURAGING, PENDING THE SECOND HALF. H1 PF 0.92199683 on 410 trades against the full sample's 0.89445064 on 833, and the win rates are nearly identical -- 36.59% versus 36.61%. Drawdown is much lower on the half (27.59% vs 42.50%), which is expected when a shorter window has less room to compound a bad run. If the halves prove close, v24's 0.894 is a real property of the mechanism rather than an average of two regimes, which is the opposite of what the BTC base did (1.3552 early, 0.6566 late). DO NOT CONCLUDE YET: H1 alone cannot settle this, and the implied H2 near 0.87 is arithmetic, not a measurement. v28b next cycle.

name: 3M ELITE v28b second half (walk-forward)
description: Second half of the walk-forward split of v24, finishing the experiment. Pine byte-identical to v24 and v28a; only the window changes. This window contains the 2024-2025 bull run and the 2026 action, a genuinely different market from H1's 2022 bear and 2023 recovery.
notes: THE HALVES AGREE. v24 IS A STABLE NUMBER. H1 PF 0.92199683 on 410 trades at 36.59% win; H2 PF 0.86121615 on 423 trades at 36.64% win; full sample 0.89445064 on 833 at 36.61%. The profit-factor spread is 0.061 and the WIN RATES MATCH TO WITHIN 0.05 PERCENTAGE POINTS across two completely different markets -- a bear and recovery in H1, a bull run in H2. Contrast the BTC base, which split 1.3552 / 0.6566, a spread of 0.699. So v24's 0.894 is a real property of the mechanism, the v25-v27 exit conclusions stand as measured, and the 2.6-point win-rate deficit is a genuine stable target rather than an averaging artifact.

name: 3M ELITE v29 no zone touch
description: HARD LESSON 15 applied here: the binding test on a SIGNAL term. One change from v24: low <= dzTop removed, the actual zone TOUCH, the condition a supply/demand system is named for. dzAge >= 1 retained so sequencing survives.
notes: THE ZONE TOUCH IS NOT DOING THE WORK -- THE BTC PATTERN, NOT THE WAR FORMATION ONE. PF 0.89445064 -> 0.97210749, the closest to 1.0 this lab has ever been, and the win rate rose 36.61% -> 39.87% on 833 -> 1,076 trades. The 243 extra trades are net accretive. REVERTED STRICTLY ON DRAWDOWN, which worsened 42.50% -> 61.45%, and the ratchet is both terms or nothing. But the finding stands: the condition this system is NAMED for -- price trading back into the zone -- is not what carries it. What remains is 'a demand zone is live and price is above its base', which is closer to a trend condition than a zone condition. FREE E14 FINDING, no credit: dzTouch < 2 in the entry is redundant with the lifecycle's own dzLive kill.

name: 3M ELITE v30 zone freshness (NEW BASE)
description: One change from v24: entries require dzAge <= 12, so a zone is only tradeable within 12 four-hour candles of creation. Taken from v24 rather than stacked onto v29, so the result is attributable. FIRST CHANGE EVER KEPT IN THIS LAB.
notes: KEPT ON THE RATCHET, BUT READ IT HONESTLY. PF 0.89445064 -> 0.89710112 and drawdown 42.49990566% -> 40.78978663%, so both terms improved and the rule says keep. THE PROFIT-FACTOR GAIN IS +0.0027, WHICH IS NOISE -- the real change is 1.7 percentage points of drawdown for 22 fewer trades. So zone age is a mild risk improvement, not an edge improvement, and it should not be described as one. What it does establish is that unbounded zone lifetime was costing something, which is the same class of defect as the deepest-zone lock-up v22 found. First change ever kept in this lab; still nowhere near tradeable at PF 0.897 and 40.8% drawdown.

name: 3M ELITE v2 -- Type 2 validation gate
description: v1 plus the TYPE 2 VALIDATION GATE decoded from VOCABULARY.md: after a zone tap, an engulfing candle in the direction of bias must print on the 48m structure timeframe before entry is allowed (state machine: tap arms a wait, engulfing candle validates it, a zone-bias flip clears it). Type 1 (3M/triple-M candle) still not implemented -- anatomy undefined. Stop/TP and everything else unchanged from v1 (3H zone-edge structural stop, 12x ATR take profit) so this run isolates the effect of the validation gate alone.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// 3M ELITE v2 — BTCUSDT, 1m base chart.
// Same cascade as v1: BIAS 12H -> ZONE 3H -> STRUCTURE 48m -> ENTRY 3m.
//
// CHANGE FROM v1 (single experiment this cycle): implements the TYPE 2 VALIDATION GATE decoded
// from the transcripts (VOCABULARY.md). v1 had NO validation gate at all — a zone tap was enough
// to trade. The source requires that after a zone tap, price may NOT drop to the entry timeframe
// until the zone produces a Type 1 (3M/triple-M candle, anatomy still undefined) or Type 2
// (engulfing candle in the direction of bias) confirmation, checked ONLY on the STRUCTURE
// timeframe (48m for this variant, per the author's own 1m-entry/15m-validation example scaled by
// the checklists' ratios). Type 1 is not implemented (undefined anatomy) — this build is Type 2 only,
// exactly as SYSTEM.md queue item 0a specifies. Zone invalidation (0b) and protected-low/high stops
// (0c) are NOT part of this change — stop placement is unchanged from v1 (3H zone edge) so this
// experiment isolates the effect of the validation gate alone.
strategy("3M ELITE v2 — Type 2 validation", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

maxBreakHi = input.int(6,    "Max breaks on bias/zone/structure")
maxBreakEn = input.int(4,    "Max breaks on the entry timeframe")
kcMult     = input.float(2.0,"Keltner width for overextension, x ATR")
slopeLen   = input.int(10,   "Bars used for MA slope")
zoneTolK   = input.float(0.25,"Zone tap tolerance, x atr(30)")
bufK       = input.float(0.25,"Structural stop buffer, x atr(30)")
tpATR      = input.float(12.0,"Take profit, x ATR (source's ATR method)")
minRpct    = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct    = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars    = input.int(1440, "Max bars in trade")

MS3M  = 180000
MS48M = 2880000
MS3H  = 10800000
MS12H = 43200000

b3   = math.floor(time / MS3M)
b48  = math.floor(time / MS48M)
b3h  = math.floor(time / MS3H)
b12h = math.floor(time / MS12H)

new3   = b3   != b3[1]
new48  = b48  != b48[1]
new3h  = b3h  != b3h[1]
new12h = b12h != b12h[1]

// ---------- reconstructed candles: open/high/low, and the previous completed close ----------
var float o3 = na
var float h3 = na
var float l3 = na
var float c3prev = na
var float c3prev2 = na
if new3
    c3prev2 := c3prev
    c3prev  := close[1]
    o3 := open
    h3 := high
    l3 := low
else
    h3 := na(h3) ? high : math.max(h3, high)
    l3 := na(l3) ? low  : math.min(l3, low)

// 48m: now also tracks OPEN so a completed 48m candle's body is known, needed for the
// engulfing-candle validation test (Type 2). v1 only tracked high/low here.
var float o48     = na
var float h48     = na
var float l48     = na
var float o48prev = na
var float o48prev2 = na
var float c48prev = na
var float c48prev2 = na
if new48
    o48prev2 := o48prev
    c48prev2 := c48prev
    o48prev  := o48
    c48prev  := close[1]
    o48 := open
    h48 := high
    l48 := low
else
    h48 := na(h48) ? high : math.max(h48, high)
    l48 := na(l48) ? low  : math.min(l48, low)

var float c3hH = na
var float c3hL = na
var float p3hH = na
var float p3hL = na
var float c3hprev = na
var float c3hprev2 = na
if new3h
    c3hprev2 := c3hprev
    c3hprev  := close[1]
    p3hH := c3hH
    p3hL := c3hL
    c3hH := high
    c3hL := low
else
    c3hH := na(c3hH) ? high : math.max(c3hH, high)
    c3hL := na(c3hL) ? low  : math.min(c3hL, low)

var float c12prev = na
var float c12prev2 = na
if new12h
    c12prev2 := c12prev
    c12prev  := close[1]

// ---------- LAYER 1: BIAS (12H) model = two consecutive same-direction closes ----------
biasBull = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev > c12prev2
biasBear = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev < c12prev2

// ---------- LAYER 2: ZONE (3H) model agrees + supply/demand tap ----------
zoneBull = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev > c3hprev2
zoneBear = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev < c3hprev2

atr30 = ta.atr(30)
tol   = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * zoneTolK
// demand tap: price trades back down into the previous completed 3H candle's low area
demandTap = not na(p3hL) and low  <= p3hL + tol
supplyTap = not na(p3hH) and high >= p3hH - tol

// ---------- LAYER 3: STRUCTURE (48m) model agrees (unchanged from v1: two consecutive closes) ----------
structBull = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev > c48prev2
structBear = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev < c48prev2

// ---------- TYPE 2 VALIDATION: engulfing 48m candle in the direction of bias ----------
// Bullish engulfing: the completed 48m candle is green and its body fully encloses the prior
// completed 48m candle's body. Bearish engulfing is the mirror test on its own inputs (not derived
// from the bullish test — HARD LESSON 6: audit every leg separately, never mirror one off the other).
bull48Body    = not na(c48prev) and not na(o48prev) and c48prev > o48prev
bear48Body    = not na(c48prev) and not na(o48prev) and c48prev < o48prev
prevBodyHi    = not na(o48prev2) and not na(c48prev2) ? math.max(o48prev2, c48prev2) : na
prevBodyLo    = not na(o48prev2) and not na(c48prev2) ? math.min(o48prev2, c48prev2) : na
engulfBull    = new48 and bull48Body and not na(prevBodyHi) and not na(prevBodyLo) and o48prev <= prevBodyLo and c48prev >= prevBodyHi
engulfBear    = new48 and bear48Body and not na(prevBodyHi) and not na(prevBodyLo) and o48prev >= prevBodyHi and c48prev <= prevBodyLo

// state machine: a zone tap ARMS the wait; the next qualifying 48m engulfing candle VALIDATES it;
// a regime flip (zone bias no longer agrees) clears both the wait and any stale validation.
var bool awaitLong  = false
var bool awaitShort = false
var bool validLong  = false
var bool validShort = false

// arm only on a FRESH tap (not already awaiting or already validated) — otherwise a persistent
// tap (price sitting near the zone for many 1m bars) would re-arm and immediately clear a
// just-earned validation on every single bar, since demandTap/supplyTap are current-bar tests.
if zoneBull and demandTap and not awaitLong and not validLong
    awaitLong := true
if zoneBear and supplyTap and not awaitShort and not validShort
    awaitShort := true

if awaitLong and engulfBull
    validLong := true
    awaitLong := false
if awaitShort and engulfBear
    validShort := true
    awaitShort := false

if not zoneBull
    validLong := false
    awaitLong := false
if not zoneBear
    validShort := false
    awaitShort := false

// ---------- break counting: a break is a close beyond the prior 20-bar extreme ----------
brkUpLvl = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
brkDnLvl = ta.lowest(low,  20)[1]
brokeUp  = ta.crossover(close, brkUpLvl)
brokeDn  = ta.crossunder(close, brkDnLvl)
var int upCount = 0
var int dnCount = 0
if brokeUp
    upCount := upCount + 1
    dnCount := 0
if brokeDn
    dnCount := dnCount + 1
    upCount := 0

// ---------- MAs on the entry timeframe ----------
ma20  = ta.ema(close, 20)
ma50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ma200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

// Keltner overextension around the 20MA (the 30SEC checklist names Keltner explicitly)
atr14  = ta.atr(14)
kcUp   = ma20 + kcMult * atr14
kcDn   = ma20 - kcMult * atr14
notExtLong  = close < kcUp
notExtShort = close > kcDn

// MAs not FULLY against bias: all three stacked the wrong way is the veto
fullyAgainstLong  = ma20 < ma50 and ma50 < ma200
fullyAgainstShort = ma20 > ma50 and ma50 > ma200

// 20 & 50 not overextended from the 200
maSpreadOk = not na(ma200) and ma200 > 0 and math.abs(ma20 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0 and math.abs(ma50 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0

// slope gate: either the 20 or the 50 must favour the trade
slope20Up = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 > ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Up = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 > ma50[slopeLen]
slope20Dn = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 < ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Dn = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 < ma50[slopeLen]
slopeOkLong  = slope20Up or slope50Up
slopeOkShort = slope20Dn or slope50Dn

// ---------- the gated cascade — demandTap/supplyTap replaced by validLong/validShort ----------
longStack  = biasBull and zoneBull and structBull and validLong  and notExtLong  and not fullyAgainstLong  and maSpreadOk and slopeOkLong  and upCount <= maxBreakEn and dnCount <= maxBreakHi
shortStack = biasBear and zoneBear and structBear and validShort and notExtShort and not fullyAgainstShort and maSpreadOk and slopeOkShort and dnCount <= maxBreakEn and upCount <= maxBreakHi

// entry trigger on the 3m close, in the direction of bias
goLong  = longStack  and new3 and close > o3
goShort = shortStack and new3 and close < o3

// ---------- risk: structural stop beyond the zone, ATR take profit per the source (unchanged from v1) ----------
buf  = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawLongR  = na(p3hL) ? na : close - (p3hL - buf)
rawShortR = na(p3hH) ? na : (p3hH + buf) - close
longR     = na(rawLongR)  ? na : math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = na(rawShortR) ? na : math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and not na(longR) and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and not na(shortR) and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(biasBull ? 1 : biasBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Bias12H")
plot(zoneBull ? 1 : zoneBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Zone3H")
plot(structBull ? 1 : structBear ? -1 : 0, title="Struct48m")
plot(validLong  ? 1 : 0,                   title="ValidLong")
plot(validShort ? 1 : 0,                   title="ValidShort")
plot(upCount,                              title="BreaksUp")
plot(dnCount,                              title="BreaksDown")
notes: [CLOUD ROUTINE LINEAGE] REJECTED -- did not beat v1 on either profit factor or max drawdown (worse on both: PF 0.64 vs 0.91, maxDD 12.1% vs 3.47%). Adding the validation gate roughly 4.6x'd trade count (20 -> 92) by requiring far less of the zone-tap coincidence and letting the 48m engulfing test fire independently of the original demandTap/supplyTap instant condition, which changed which setups qualify rather than only filtering v1's setups down. Leg split: longs 23 trades, 11 winners (47.8%), net -$860.79; shorts 69 trades, 20 winners (29.0%), net -$259.83 -- both legs now net losers, the inverse of v1 where longs alone carried the profit. avgBarsLosing 132.3 vs avgBarsWinning 255.7 (ratio 0.52) is the HARD LESSON 5/6 diagnostic flashing again: losers are dying about twice as fast as winners run, meaning the unchanged zone-edge stop (not touched by this experiment) is still too close to noise for the setups this gate now selects. Best-known config stays v1. Next: either implement 0b (zone invalidation) and 0c (protected low/high stop) together -- the source's protected-low stop is exactly the fix HARD LESSON 5/6 is asking for here -- or test the validation gate alone against a materially wider stop before concluding the gate itself is bad.

name: 3M ELITE v3 -- protected low/high stop
description: v2's Type 2 validation gate unchanged, plus the PROTECTED LOW/HIGH stop decoded from VOCABULARY.md (queue 0c, raised priority ahead of 0b after v2's diagnostic): the moment a zone tap validates via the 48m engulfing candle, that same candle's own low (protected low, longs) or high (protected high, shorts) is captured and held until the zone bias flips. Entries stop beyond this protected level instead of v1/v2's 3H zone edge. Isolates the stop fix alone -- zone invalidation (0b) and Type 1 (undefined anatomy) are still not implemented.

// 3M ELITE v3 — BTCUSDT, 1m base chart.
// Same cascade as v1/v2: BIAS 12H -> ZONE 3H -> STRUCTURE 48m -> ENTRY 3m.
//
// CHANGE FROM v2 (single experiment this cycle): implements the PROTECTED LOW/HIGH stop decoded
// from the transcripts (VOCABULARY.md, "Type 1/Type 2 validation" section — "the second we get
// that, we can draw out our 15 minute low and we are now valid"). This is SYSTEM.md queue item 0c,
// whose own note says it was "raised priority after 0a, ahead of 0b (zone invalidation)": v2's

// 5/6 signature) pointed at the stop, which v2 left unchanged from v1 (the 3H zone edge). That zone
// edge is much farther from price than the 48m structure that actually validated the trade, so it
// was never a tight, structural stop for THIS gate's setups.
//
// v3 keeps v2's Type 2 validation gate unchanged and replaces the stop: the moment a zone tap
// validates (engulfing 48m candle in the direction of bias), the LOW of that same 48m candle is
// captured as the protected low (protected high for shorts) and held fixed until the zone bias
// flips (same clear condition v2 already uses for validLong/validShort). Entries stop beyond this
// protected level instead of the 3H zone edge. Type 1 (3M/triple-M candle) still not implemented —
// anatomy undefined. Zone invalidation (0b) is NOT part of this change, by design — this experiment
// isolates the effect of the protected-stop fix alone, per HARD LESSON 6 (one change per cycle).

     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

maxBreakHi = input.int(6,    "Max breaks on bias/zone/structure")
maxBreakEn = input.int(4,    "Max breaks on the entry timeframe")
kcMult     = input.float(2.0,"Keltner width for overextension, x ATR")
slopeLen   = input.int(10,   "Bars used for MA slope")
zoneTolK   = input.float(0.25,"Zone tap tolerance, x atr(30)")
bufK       = input.float(0.25,"Protected-stop buffer, x atr(30)")
tpATR      = input.float(12.0,"Take profit, x ATR (source's ATR method)")
minRpct    = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct    = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars    = input.int(1440, "Max bars in trade")

MS3M  = 180000
MS48M = 2880000
MS3H  = 10800000
MS12H = 43200000

b3   = math.floor(time / MS3M)
b48  = math.floor(time / MS48M)
b3h  = math.floor(time / MS3H)
b12h = math.floor(time / MS12H)

new3   = b3   != b3[1]
new48  = b48  != b48[1]
new3h  = b3h  != b3h[1]
new12h = b12h != b12h[1]

var float o3 = na

//@version=6
// 3M ELITE v5 — BTCUSDT, 1m base chart.
// Same cascade as v1: BIAS 12H -> ZONE 3H -> STRUCTURE 48m -> ENTRY 3m.
//
// CHANGE FROM v1 (single experiment this cycle, AUTOMATIC TOP PRIORITY per VOCABULARY.md): implements
// the ONE CANDLE RULE decoded from the transcripts (VOCABULARY.md, "✅ ONE CANDLE RULE — DECODED").
// This gate had NOT been implemented in any prior build (v1-v4 implemented Type 2 validation, the
// protected stop and zone invalidation, but never this one), so per this project's standing rule a
// decoded-but-unimplemented VOCABULARY.md definition jumps ahead of the queue (0e).
//
// The source: "Once the zone gets created with the engulfing candle, when you get the next candle
// tapping into it and also making a new high -- this is called the one candle rule -- this one candle
// does not mitigate the zone yet. So if we get a second candle that continues up without being a
// triple M, and it's not a pullback, then that would mitigate the zone." Applies to every zone type.
//
// Mechanical reading used here (v1's zone model, not v2-v4's persistent-zone state machine): v1
// treats the zone as the most recently completed 3H candle's range, refreshed every 3H bar. Under
// that model the rule becomes: if the zone gets breached (closed beyond) by the 3H candle that traded
// against it AND the candle immediately before it ALSO closed beyond that same edge (two consecutive
// extensions with no pullback in between), the zone is MITIGATED -- an exhausted level, not a level
// price is respecting -- and no new entry may be taken off it. A single extending candle, or an
// extension followed by a pullback (close back inside), does NOT mitigate, matching "this one candle
// does not mitigate the zone yet."
// Known approximation: the source's exception ("unless it's a triple M") is not modeled, because
// Type 1 (the 3M/triple-M candle) still has no defined anatomy anywhere in the transcripts
// (VOCABULARY.md "STILL MISSING"). Documented here rather than guessed at.
// Everything else (stop = 3H zone edge, TP = 12x ATR, all other gates) is unchanged from v1 so this
// run isolates the effect of the One Candle Rule gate alone.
strategy("3M ELITE v5 — One Candle Rule zone mitigation", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

maxBreakHi = input.int(6,    "Max breaks on bias/zone/structure")
maxBreakEn = input.int(4,    "Max breaks on the entry timeframe")
kcMult     = input.float(2.0,"Keltner width for overextension, x ATR")
slopeLen   = input.int(10,   "Bars used for MA slope")
zoneTolK   = input.float(0.25,"Zone tap tolerance, x atr(30)")
bufK       = input.float(0.25,"Structural stop buffer, x atr(30)")
tpATR      = input.float(12.0,"Take profit, x ATR (source's ATR method)")
minRpct    = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct    = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars    = input.int(1440, "Max bars in trade")

MS3M  = 180000
MS48M = 2880000
MS3H  = 10800000
MS12H = 43200000

b3   = math.floor(time / MS3M)
b48  = math.floor(time / MS48M)
b3h  = math.floor(time / MS3H)
b12h = math.floor(time / MS12H)

new3   = b3   != b3[1]
new48  = b48  != b48[1]
new3h  = b3h  != b3h[1]
new12h = b12h != b12h[1]

// ---------- reconstructed candles: open/high/low, and the previous completed close ----------
var float o3 = na
var float h3 = na
var float l3 = na
var float c3prev = na
var float c3prev2 = na
if new3
    c3prev2 := c3prev
    c3prev  := close[1]
    o3 := open
    h3 := high
    l3 := low
else
    h3 := na(h3) ? high : math.max(h3, high)
    l3 := na(l3) ? low  : math.min(l3, low)

var float h48 = na
var float l48 = na
var float c48prev = na
var float c48prev2 = na
if new48
    c48prev2 := c48prev
    c48prev  := close[1]
    h48 := high
    l48 := low
else
    h48 := na(h48) ? high : math.max(h48, high)
    l48 := na(l48) ? low  : math.min(l48, low)

var float c3hH = na
var float c3hL = na
var float p3hH = na
var float p3hL = na
var float c3hprev = na
var float c3hprev2 = na

// One Candle Rule state: consecutive-extension streak and mitigation flag per side, evaluated each
// time a 3H candle completes, against the zone edge that candle actually traded against (the OLD
// p3hL/p3hH, captured here BEFORE this block overwrites them below).
var int  extStreakLo   = 0
var int  extStreakHi   = 0
var bool mitigatedLo   = false
var bool mitigatedHi   = false

if new3h
    // the candle that just completed: its low/high are still in c3hL/c3hH, its close is close[1].
    // the zone it traded against is the OLD p3hL/p3hH, not yet reassigned this bar.
    if not na(p3hL)
        extendedLo = c3hL < p3hL and close[1] < p3hL
        extStreakLo := extendedLo ? extStreakLo + 1 : 0
        if extStreakLo >= 2
            mitigatedLo := true
        else if not extendedLo
            mitigatedLo := false
    if not na(p3hH)
        extendedHi = c3hH > p3hH and close[1] > p3hH
        extStreakHi := extendedHi ? extStreakHi + 1 : 0
        if extStreakHi >= 2
            mitigatedHi := true
        else if not extendedHi
            mitigatedHi := false

    c3hprev2 := c3hprev
    c3hprev  := close[1]
    p3hH := c3hH
    p3hL := c3hL
    c3hH := high
    c3hL := low
else
    c3hH := na(c3hH) ? high : math.max(c3hH, high)
    c3hL := na(c3hL) ? low  : math.min(c3hL, low)

var float c12prev = na
var float c12prev2 = na
if new12h
    c12prev2 := c12prev
    c12prev  := close[1]

// ---------- LAYER 1: BIAS (12H) model = two consecutive same-direction closes ----------
biasBull = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev > c12prev2
biasBear = not na(c12prev) and not na(c12prev2) and c12prev < c12prev2

// ---------- LAYER 2: ZONE (3H) model agrees + supply/demand tap, gated by the One Candle Rule ----------
zoneBull = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev > c3hprev2
zoneBear = not na(c3hprev) and not na(c3hprev2) and c3hprev < c3hprev2

atr30 = ta.atr(30)
tol   = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * zoneTolK
// demand tap: price trades back down into the previous completed 3H candle's low area
demandTap = not na(p3hL) and low  <= p3hL + tol and not mitigatedLo
supplyTap = not na(p3hH) and high >= p3hH - tol and not mitigatedHi

// ---------- LAYER 3: STRUCTURE (48m) model agrees ----------
structBull = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev > c48prev2
structBear = not na(c48prev) and not na(c48prev2) and c48prev < c48prev2

// ---------- break counting: a break is a close beyond the prior 20-bar extreme ----------
brkUpLvl = ta.highest(high, 20)[1]
brkDnLvl = ta.lowest(low,  20)[1]
brokeUp  = ta.crossover(close, brkUpLvl)
brokeDn  = ta.crossunder(close, brkDnLvl)
var int upCount = 0
var int dnCount = 0
if brokeUp
    upCount := upCount + 1
    dnCount := 0
if brokeDn
    dnCount := dnCount + 1
    upCount := 0

// ---------- MAs on the entry timeframe ----------
ma20  = ta.ema(close, 20)
ma50  = ta.ema(close, 50)
ma200 = ta.ema(close, 200)

// Keltner overextension around the 20MA (the 30SEC checklist names Keltner explicitly)
atr14  = ta.atr(14)
kcUp   = ma20 + kcMult * atr14
kcDn   = ma20 - kcMult * atr14
notExtLong  = close < kcUp
notExtShort = close > kcDn

// MAs not FULLY against bias: all three stacked the wrong way is the veto
fullyAgainstLong  = ma20 < ma50 and ma50 < ma200
fullyAgainstShort = ma20 > ma50 and ma50 > ma200

// 20 & 50 not overextended from the 200
maSpreadOk = not na(ma200) and ma200 > 0 and math.abs(ma20 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0 and math.abs(ma50 - ma200) / ma200 * 100 < 5.0

// slope gate: either the 20 or the 50 must favour the trade
slope20Up = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 > ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Up = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 > ma50[slopeLen]
slope20Dn = not na(ma20[slopeLen]) and ma20 < ma20[slopeLen]
slope50Dn = not na(ma50[slopeLen]) and ma50 < ma50[slopeLen]
slopeOkLong  = slope20Up or slope50Up
slopeOkShort = slope20Dn or slope50Dn

// ---------- the gated cascade ----------
longStack  = biasBull and zoneBull and structBull and demandTap and notExtLong  and not fullyAgainstLong  and maSpreadOk and slopeOkLong  and upCount <= maxBreakEn and dnCount <= maxBreakHi
shortStack = biasBear and zoneBear and structBear and supplyTap and notExtShort and not fullyAgainstShort and maSpreadOk and slopeOkShort and dnCount <= maxBreakEn and upCount <= maxBreakHi

// entry trigger on the 3m close, in the direction of bias
goLong  = longStack  and new3 and close > o3
goShort = shortStack and new3 and close < o3

// ---------- risk: structural stop beyond the zone, ATR take profit per the source ----------
buf  = na(atr30) ? 0.0 : atr30 * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawLongR  = na(p3hL) ? na : close - (p3hL - buf)
rawShortR = na(p3hH) ? na : (p3hH + buf) - close
longR     = na(rawLongR)  ? na : math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = na(rawShortR) ? na : math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and not na(longR) and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and not na(shortR) and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - atr14 * tpATR
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(biasBull ? 1 : biasBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Bias12H")
plot(zoneBull ? 1 : zoneBear ? -1 : 0,     title="Zone3H")
plot(structBull ? 1 : structBear ? -1 : 0, title="Struct48m")
plot(mitigatedLo ? 1 : 0,                  title="ZoneMitigatedLo")
plot(mitigatedHi ? 1 : 0,                  title="ZoneMitigatedHi")
plot(upCount,                              title="BreaksUp")
plot(dnCount,                              title="BreaksDown")

The rule needs a PERSISTENT zone (like v2/v3/v4's arm-on-tap state machine) to have any teeth at all.
